name: JCC Milwaukee Mah Jongg
description: Weekly open play at the Harry & Rose Samson Family JCC (Whitefish Bay). Official page: "the American adaptation which uses a card of Standard Hands. Each year, the National Mah Jongg League puts out a new card with fresh hands to play." All experience levels welcome; solo players are matched with others.
address: 6255 N. Santa Monica Blvd., Milwaukee, WI 53217 (West Entrance; Whitefish Bay)

name: MKE Mahjong
description: Milwaukee-area American mahjong lessons and parties taught by Julie Littman (Oh My Mahjong certified). Official page: American Mah Jongg using National Mah Jongg League rules. Travels to homes/offices/clubs in Milwaukee and suburbs; no fixed venue.
schedule: By arrangement (text/email); group lesson $50/person for groups of 3+; private $150 per 2-hour session

name: Hales Corners Mahjong Club
description: Hales Corners (suburb) club listed on Bam Good Time; open play for experienced players. Page does not mention American/NMJL; no dates scheduled.
